recognition.title: Innovate UK Women in Innovation Award 2025/26
recognition.text: Dr. Maryna Kuzmenko was named a winner, announced on 5 August 2026, for MooMore, AI thermal imaging for early lameness detection in dairy cattle. The award carries a £75,000 grant and a twelve-month programme running to June 2027; she was one of 61 grant winners among 100 women recognised from 1,590 applications.
